name: WhosWho
tagline: Create PDF documents with people pictures and corresponding name, also called "who's who", "yearbook" or "facebook"
blurb: From a set of pictures and names, WhosWho creates a PDF document with faces and corresponding names, as used in schools.
description:
From a set of pictures and names, WhosWho creates a PDF document with
faces and corresponding names, as used in schools. WhosWho tries to make
things as simple as possible for the user:

• Pictures can be automatically cropped to keep only the person's
face.

• If you have a ODS/XLSX file containing people's name, just export
it to CSV and WhosWho will be able to use it.

• A default picture can be used if you do not have a person's
picture.

• Multiple sheet layouts are available (A4, A3, portrait, landscape…)
each one in 150 and 300 DPI.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
